description: Read one product by merchant_id + product_id (0x-prefixed bytes32): commission and cashback rates, name, description, category, product type, product card URI, product rank and creation time. The commission rate here is the LIVE rate SplitRouter reads at settlement, not a rate locked to any past purchase. Unauthenticated, mirroring GET /v1/merchant/product — a delisted product reads as not-found. Includes endpoint_url, where this product is paid: on the x402 rail a ref link from ANY review of this merchant can be presented there, and the merchant's 402 names the product actually sold.

chain_id.description: EVM chain id; omit for Base

name: get_product
